hero.title: All of Arad in one app
hero.text: Events with tickets, sights with an audio guide, offers from local businesses and community actions that earn you points. For people visiting the city and for people who live here.

features.title: What you can do with the app

events.title: Events and tickets
events.text: What's on today, this weekend or this week. Buy the ticket in the app and get in with the QR code.

guide.title: Virtual guide
guide.text: The Fortress, the Cultural Palace, the Classic Theatre and more, explained stop by stop, in text and audio.

offers.title: Local offers
offers.text: Cafés, producers and wineries in Arad. Claim an offer and get a code to show at the counter.

community.title: Community and points
community.text: Sign up for City Hall actions, earn points when you're confirmed and spend them at partner businesses.

transport.title: Public transport
transport.text: Tram lines and the full route to where you want to go, with the stops on the map.

ai.title: AI assistant and day plan
ai.text: Ask what to do with the kids this weekend or get a one-day plan for Arad, with times and a route.

now.title: Now in Arad
now.text: A few of the events in the app. Details, tickets and directions are in the app.
now.empty: Events show up here as soon as they're published.

community.title: Do something for the city, earn points
community.text: Tree planting, clean-ups, blood donation. Sign up in the app, show your QR code at the action and spend the points at partner cafés and producers.
community.pageText: Community actions by Arad City Hall: sign up in the app and, once confirmed, earn points you can spend at partner businesses.

steps.1: Pick an action in the app and sign up.
steps.2: Show your QR code at the action; a volunteer or City Hall scans it.
steps.3: Get the points and climb this month's leaderboard.

community.soonTitle: The list of actions and the leaderboard will show up here soon
community.soonText: Until then you'll find them in the app, in the Community tab on Home.

visitor.title: Visitor
visitor.text: What to do today, guides at sights, a plan for the day.

local.title: Local
local.text: Events, offers and points for what you do in the city.

business.title: Local business
business.text: Offers, events and announcements, code validation.

city.title: City Hall
city.text: The city agenda, community actions, sights and guides.

volunteer.title: Volunteer
volunteer.text: Scan participants at actions, right from the app.

panels.title: City Hall or a business?
panels.text: The web dashboard is for desk work: events, offers, community actions, validations and stats.
